fields.what_it_is: The Spartan eCoil™ System is a mechanically detachable embolic coil system that consists of an embolic coil (the Spartan eCoil™) attached to a delivery wire with a fluoroscopic marker band and the system is housed in an introducer sheath. The system is provided sterile and requires no additional equipment to be employed by the user. The system is constructed of implant grade materials. The system comes in 57 different configurations, two (2) shape configurations and a range of primary and secondary diameters and coil lengths. The Delivery Wire includes a radiopaque marker used as a positioning reference.

fields.indications: The Spartan eCoil™ System is indicated for the endovascular embolization of intracranial aneurysms and other neurovascular abnormalities, such as arteriovenous malformations and arteriovenous fistulae. The Spartan eCoil™ System is also indicated for arterial and venous embolizations in the peripheral vasculature.
fields.compatible_with: The Spartan eCoilTM System is designed to work with market available microcatheters with minimum working inner diameters of at least 0.017".
